title: Primary Historical Witnesses — Potato Physical Dome-World, Early Holonomy Loom, and Ambiance Runtimes
author: Assistant-prepared under contemporaneous TD613 operator instruction
human_request_ref: 2026-10-23 operator instruction: prepare additive primary-witness intake for Information Dome using existing SRC-TWINPDF and SRC-TWINENG, exact historical source hashes, and established intake schema
body: Primary-witness recovery documents the historical provenance of Potato's physical Dome-World and the TD613 computational Holonomy Loom. Cites existing reference sources SRC-TWINPDF and SRC-TWINENG for the 45-page Strategic Planning Committee briefing and engineering review. Records SHA-256 digests for native ecological grammar (78af99d9b1385de99f44351fbcd77dc50816c746e1268e8788563653bd4a0749), physical binary loom (d67745729e4f9aa5a8af1f8277fbcbb8cc064ef697d599a58f2203bc166a1e4c), early v0.2.1 computational holonomy runtime (c04fe9d5f71381812394d9d6e01f6c0754a62ff513322d810de1eac56d5e8baa), v0.3 ambiance sheaf runtime (d834d1a57322aff601f111fe23cdf5c48b563bd814492822a39d324ac41e1d0b), v0.4.1 Ash live lattice runtime (a2264f951742593ccfe163cf390fd48d5cf03b753318e12f47216393486198f1), and armored Domeblox Lua model (b4479a1ff2df0bd3d32197876fb6348750cebb536c32f765597c902619f8bafe). Establishes that Potato's physical Jacquard water-powered loom externalizes community memory into woven cloth across five ecological axes, whereas v0.2.1 computational holonomy evaluates route deformation vectors. Conceptual genealogy G-185 remains strictly HELD because an uninterrupted mathematical derivation across transformation stages is not established.

evidence.earned_claim: Surviving primary files establish that Potato conceived a water-driven mechanical Jacquard loom and native relational grammar; computational holonomy was implemented in v0.2.1 with endpoint displacement and rest-debt; ambiance with local sections and gluing obstructions was executed in v0.3.
evidence.claim_ceiling: Historical code, markup, and planning documents demonstrate design and local model execution only; they do not prove physical construction of the eco-village, empirical provider observation, or an unbroken mathematical derivation between physical cloth and algorithmic holonomy. Schema validity and staged presence in this repository grant no publication authority; source bytes available in the private transfer archive remain research artifacts until separately reviewed and admitted.
missing_evidence: Original dated conversation export of Amari first authoring the phrase Holonomy Loom.
Empirical witness of physical village or hydro-mechanical loom construction.
Demonstrated mathematical equivalence between physical cloth weaving and differential-geometric parallel transport.
Public publication and operator-reviewed admission of primary transfer archive contents.
